College Football - Auburn at Tennessee

The Auburn Tigers face the No. 17 Tennessee Volunteers in an SEC showdown at Neyland Stadium. Both teams enter the game with similar 3-1 records. Tennessee lost against Texas, 20-17, while Auburn defeated Vanderbilt, 21-15, in Week 4.

College Football - BYU at TCU

The Cougars (3-0) visit the Horned Frogs (2-2). Tenth-ranked BYU beat Colorado State, 41-23, behind LJ Martin's 176 yards and three touchdowns, while TCU seeks to bounce back from a 21-13 loss to UCF despite 310 passing yards from QB Jaden Craig.

College Football - Baylor at Arizona State

Baylor (3-1) visits Arizona State (2-1) at Mountain America Stadium. Last week, Baylor beat Colorado, 23-13, as QB D.J. Lagway threw two TDs, while Arizona State beat Kansas, 24-17, helped by Jaren Hamilton's 100-yard kickoff return TD.
